title: fix(console): a docs cross-link to a section keeps its #section through the flat-permalink redirect, and the page scrolls to it

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:文档门户里「扁平链接 → 书内规范链接」的跳转现在保留 `#章节` 片段;文档页加载完正文后,自动滚动到该章节标题,和页内点锚点的滚动一样。
- 为什么改:showcase 首页的「cross-reference section」链接(`/_console/docs/showcase_docs_guide#cross-references`)跳转后丢了 `#cross-references`,页面停在顶部,读者找不到被引用的那一节。
- 风险与回滚:只动 Console 文档门户两个页面组件。没有片段的链接行为不变(仍停在顶部);书名→书 slug 的跳转顺带同样保留片段。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.tsx` 新增的滚动 effect(`MutationObserver` 等标题挂载);`ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocsSlug.tsx` 两处 `Navigate`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/docs-portal.test.tsx`,预期 24 条全绿,其中 objectstack#33055 一组 5 条。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocsSlug.tsx` (the `/docs/:slug` dispatcher):

- Reads `hash` from `useLocation()` and carries it on the two redirects that land on a doc's canonical in-book URL: the flat doc permalink (a `Navigate` element now given `to={{ pathname, hash }}`) and the name-prefix fallback for a name no installed doc carries.
- The redirect from a book NAME to its slug landing (no doc) is unchanged.

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.tsx` (the reader):

- New module-level `scrollHeadingIntoView(id)`: the `scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })` the in-page anchor and ToC clicks already used, now shared; `scrollToHeading` calls it.
- New landing effect: when the doc is loaded (`state === 'ready'` and the loaded doc is the route's `:name`) and the URL carries a fragment, it decodes the fragment and scrolls that heading into view. The body mounts behind `MarkdownRenderer`'s `React.lazy` boundary, so when the heading is not in the DOM yet a `MutationObserver` on the doc's `article` element (new `ref`) waits for it, scrolls once, and disconnects; it also disconnects on unmount or a new landing. A malformed `%` escape is ignored. The effect keys on `state`, `doc`, `name`, `slug` and `hash`; `slug` is there because the book-name redirect below keeps this page mounted with the doc loaded while it draws a new article.
- The book-NAME → slug redirect for a doc (`/docs/BOOKNAME/DOC` → `/docs/SLUG/DOC`) carries `hash` too. This is the bounded in-place fix the seat accepted on the claim amendment (6880635001): the same `Navigate` dropping the same fragment, in the same file.

The query string: the redirects kept none before and keep none now (the ruling's "any query string the redirect already keeps stays kept" holds vacuously).

Plus one `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/console`, whose `dist` ships these pages.

## Why

Measured at `origin/main` 24f2f401: both `DocsSlug` redirects handed `Navigate` a `to` built as a template-string path, which carries no `location.hash`, and `DocPage` had no code that reads `location.hash` at all. Only clicks inside an already-rendered doc scrolled (`onContentClick`, `onTocClick`), so even a canonical URL with a fragment, typed or followed from another doc, opened at the top.

## Tests

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/docs-portal.test.tsx` (the portal's shared harness: the real `DocsLayout` / `DocsIndex` / `DocsSlug` / `DocPage` under the real route table, driven through `MemoryRouter`), new top-level `describe` "objectstack#33055 — the #section survives the flat → canonical redirect and is scrolled to". `Element.prototype.scrollIntoView` is a spy recording the element ids it was called on.

- `/docs/crm_guide_lead#lead-scoring` lands on `/docs/crm/crm_guide_lead#lead-scoring` and scrolls `lead-scoring`.
- CONTROL: `/docs/crm_guide_lead` lands on `/docs/crm/crm_guide_lead`; after the heading has mounted, nothing was scrolled.
- `/docs/crm/crm_guide_lead#lead-scoring` opened directly scrolls `lead-scoring`.
- The name-prefix fallback `/docs/crm_not_installed#lead-scoring` lands on `/docs/crm/crm_not_installed#lead-scoring` ("Documentation not found").
- Book NAME `/docs/showcase_manual/showcase_lead_guide#lead-scoring` lands on `/docs/manual/showcase_lead_guide#lead-scoring` and scrolls `lead-scoring`.

The harness's `MarkdownRenderer` mock now turns a `{#id}` marker in a doc body into an `h2` heading with that id that mounts one tick AFTER the body (as the real renderer's lazy chunk does) and drops the marker from the body text, so every existing content assertion reads the same text. Two fixture bodies gained a marker (`crm_guide_lead`, `showcase_lead_guide`).

**Ablations** (head content `d3c61315`, each via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each anchor 1 → 0 and restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty; the tests import the pages by relative path, so no `dist` is in the path):

<details><summary>Five legs, each red on the pin it guards, then restored</summary>

```text
A1 DocsSlug flat-doc redirect without hash      -> x flat permalink with #section ... (expected '/docs/crm/crm_guide_lead' to be '/docs/crm/crm_guide_lead#lead-scoring')
                                                   Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (33055 block)
A2 DocPage landing effect returns early          -> x flat permalink ..., x canonical URL opened directly ..., x book NAME ...
                                                   Tests 3 failed | 2 passed
A3 DocPage book-name redirect without hash       -> x book NAME reader segment ...   Tests 1 failed | 4 passed
A4 slug dropped from the landing effect's keys   -> x book NAME reader segment ...   Tests 1 failed | 4 passed
A5 DocsSlug name-prefix fallback without hash    -> x the name-prefix fallback redirect keeps the fragment too   Tests 1 failed | 4 passed
every leg: ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

</details>

The CONTROL stays green under every leg, as it should: nothing in this diff runs without a fragment.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live showcase check: NOT RUN.** Confirming on the stock showcase (`/_console/docs/manual/showcase_index` → the cross-reference link) needs a full build, the showcase backend and the built Console; it was not run in this thread. The reachability is driven through the real router and the real page components in jsdom instead (above).
- **The vi.mock factory spells its JSX tags with explicit closing tags.** `check:vi-mock-inherit`'s shared masker reads a self-closing `/>` that follows `}` as a regex literal (the open half of objectui#7882), so the first factory shape was refused as "the argument list does not balance". The factory says so in one comment line. class: observation (known, carried) · reach: none · carrier: objectui#7882.
- **Observed, not changed.** The portal's redirects drop the query string as they did before. No docs URL reads one today. class: observation · reach: none · carrier: none.
